title: K6WP DisplaysConfig
description: Per-monitor assignment store for the K6WP wallpaper engine. Stored at %LOCALAPPDATA%/K6WP/displays.json. Deliberately separate from config.json: older Studio builds rewrite config.json from their own WallpaperConfig struct and would erase an assignment map stored there (same rationale as playlist.json). Engine reads the file (and watches it); Studio writes it. Version 0 (legacy/absent) is migrated to version 1 by the loader. On migration (or corrupt input) the loader backs up the original bytes to <file>.bak and rewrites the file at the current version.

version.description: Schema version. 0 = legacy (missing fields are defaulted on load), 1 = current.

assignments.description: Per-monitor video assignments, keyed by the GDI device name as returned by MONITORINFOEXW.szDevice (e.g. \\.\DISPLAY1). Each value names the video file that plays on that monitor. Empty object = no per-monitor assignment (engine falls back to config.json playback state).

path.description: Absolute path to the wallpaper video file, UTF-8 encoded. Must be non-empty and must not contain a '..' path component; values outside those rules are rejected by ValidateDisplays.

exists.description: Studio-side existence hint recorded at write time (matches the {path,exists} QML shape of playlist items). The engine re-checks the filesystem at apply time and does not trust this flag.

displays.description: Display-only metadata Studio may write (orientation notes, friendly names, ...). The engine IGNORES this array; it is preserved as raw JSON across load/save round-trips.
